import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_sf_airy_Ai_deriv_e(const double x, gsl_mode_t mode, gsl_sf_result * result)
gsl.gsl_sf_airy_Ai_deriv_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(GslSfResult)]
gsl.gsl_sf_airy_Ai_deriv_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Define the function to compute the derivative
def compute_airy_ai_deriv(x, mode):
    result = GslSfResult()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_airy_Ai_deriv_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.c_int(mode), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Error in computation: status code {status}")
    return result.val

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test cases
    assert abs(compute_airy_ai_deriv(1.0, 0) - -0.159) < 0.001, "Test case 1 failed"
    try:
        compute_airy_ai_deriv(5.0, 0)
    except RuntimeError as e:
        assert str(e).startswith("Error in computation"), "Test case 2 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
